title: Feu nourri
approval_scope: Accepted revised name and concept from preceding proposal: two fixed sequences of the active weapon firing mode against one target; preserve native per-sequence projectile count; ammunition scales to projectiles fired; skill ranks improve per-projectile damage rather than sequence count. Reduced accuracy direction retained. Revised exact numbers and RP were not displayed and remain pending.
superseded_proposals: Skill-rank-driven three-to-six total projectiles regardless of native firing mode.
Replacement of ordinary weapon burst by skill-defined projectile count.
remaining_review: Revised RP, exact damage coefficients/ranges, accuracy multiplier, energy, cooldown, weapon compatibility, projectile resolution and early target death/ammunition timing remain pending where not previously accepted.
visual_approval: Existing intention only; native rendering not presented or approved.
